treatment_summary.value: Inpatient: IV fluids, bowel regimen (polyethylene glycol, sennosides), melatonin 5 mg, acetaminophen PRN, pediatric multivitamin with iron; hydroxyzine 25 mg PO q6h PRN given six times HD5 to early HD7 (152 mg total) then discontinued; quetiapine 25 mg PO nightly from HD7 plus 12.5 mg PRN on HD8; nonpharmacologic delirium interventions. Discharged on quetiapine 25 mg nightly; later used quetiapine as needed, then as-needed olanzapine; referrals to psychology and occupational therapy; special education with an individualized education program.
